title: pm-dispatch(p0): a lane's p0 is dispatched in the same round past every cap and lower-priority work pauses; finder stops the bleed, then escalation, then triage stop-bleed; main red and deterministic queue red are p0 at first touch; full-run card filed p0
body:
Fixes #27047
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:本车道的 p0 卡当轮立即派发,不再受 `batch`、深度等待(`LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD`)与任何并发上限约束;没有槽位就暂停最低优先级的在飞开发腾位(分支与 PR 原样保留、卡上记 `Paused-for:` 行、p0 落地即复活)。主干全量红与确定性队列红首触即 p0,四小时 full-run 生成的红卡也改为 p0 立卡。发现红的席位先止血;一轮无人认领即轮报点名;再一轮分诊只代派止血(每轮一张,复核不归分诊)。
- 为什么改:维护者原话「main 红为什么不是 p0?」「skills 规则应该要求对应车道 p0 的卡立刻派发」「不受并发限制,或者宁可其他开发暂停」「你需要立卡更新技能」;第 6 项裁决记录「同意,补到 #27047」「同意乙,一起写进 #27047」。
- 风险与回滚:只改四份协议文本与一个标签常量,不碰产品代码;回滚 = revert 本 PR。唯一放宽的是分诊红线的单一例外(无主 p0 的止血代派,每轮一张、复核不归分诊),其余红线与限制原样。
- 先看(按风险):① `SKILL.md` 第 35 行(红线新增的唯一例外)与第 119 行(`priority:p0` 行);② `references/landing-operations.md` 第 76–84 行(约定①及其非机械分支、约定③);③ `references/execution-duties.md` 第 25–27 行(暂停机制)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint && node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test` —— 预期全绿;ratchet 打印四份文件 319 / 188 / 101 / 102 行,各在上限、headroom 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位达档契约复核后落地(Tier S,`.claude/**`)。

## What changes

Item by item against the card's Wanted 1–6 (the ruled text; nothing beyond it, no new gate). Line numbers below are post-change unless marked `origin/main`.

1. **p0 dispatches at once, in its own lane.** `references/execution-duties.md` 〈候选与批次〉 L51 (new): on every round and every wake the lane seat's first read is its open `priority:p0`; an unclaimed one is claimed and dispatched in that same round, never the next.
2. **No concurrency cap holds a p0.** `SKILL.md` `priority:p0` row (L119) rewritten in place: same-round dispatch past `batch`, the depth wait (`LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD`) and every concurrency cap; the row's ⛔ loses 深度等待 and keeps 同文件串行与认领协议. `execution-duties.md` L25: p0 crosses the depth wait too (the old text forbade exactly that).
3. **When there is no room, other development pauses.** `execution-duties.md` L26–27 (new): no slot, or a lower-priority in-flight card holding the same files ⇒ pause the lowest-priority in-flight dev that frees the room — stop its session, hold the PR draft, claim untouched; the card gets a `Paused-for:` line naming the p0; nothing discarded, reverted or force-pushed; when the p0 lands the dev is revived on the same claim and branch (the 〈派发〉 revive rule: SendMessage first, takeover protocol only if unreachable). The SKILL.md row says this in five characters (无槽即暂停…腾位) and points at execution-duties for the mechanics. The card's ⚠️ reading ("pause" = stop the session and hold the draft) is what the text says.
4. **An unclaimed p0 escalates.** `references/landing-operations.md` 约定③ (L82): one triage round (~60 min) unclaimed ⇒ triage and the director name the card and the owning lane in that round's report.
5. **Main red and merge-queue red are p0 at first touch.** `references/triage-duties.md` L30 (new): a full red on `main` and a deterministic merge-queue red are graded p0 at first touch — the anchor, the root-cause card and the generated full-run card; a flake anchor becomes p0 only once read as deterministic (the card's ⚠️: a `queue-flake-anchor` is a name, not a diagnosis). Generator: `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` `cardIdentity().labels` `priority:p1` → `priority:p0`. That constant is the live filing path (`createIssue({ labels: identity.labels })`, called through `scheduled-full-run-card.mjs` `fileCardStep`, which `.github/workflows/scheduled-full-run-card.yml` runs). Its pin, `scheduled-full-run-card.mjs` L217 (the self-test's expected `issues.create` params), follows; so does the self-test board fixture `CARD_LABELS` (`scheduled-full-run.mjs` L1699), which `lint.yml` executes through `--self-test` and whose battery asserts only that a refresh never touches the grade labels.
6. **Finder stops the bleed → escalation → triage stop-bleed.** `landing-operations.md`: 约定① (L76) gains its non-mechanical branch (L80, 6a — the finder names the owning lane on the anchor and rings its mailbox with `Request: main-red`; the root-cause card stays with that lane; the mechanical branches — revert, or a verified-root-cause fix — were already L78–79); 约定③ (L82–84, 6b–c): still unclaimed by the round after the escalation ⇒ triage posts the standard claim line and dispatches ONE `os-dev` for the stop-bleed only; one per round, triage does not become a development lane; the stop-bleed PR's review is the lane seat's or the director's, never triage's; Tier H still waits on the governed approver; a lane seat arriving takes the card back through the claim line (the one-writer protocol). `triage-duties.md` L31 (new) carries the triage-side duty and points at 约定③. `SKILL.md` 红线 L35 (new): the line 「⛔ 分诊席永不认领、派发或写码」 gains its one exception (an unclaimed p0 anchor: round report after one round, triage stop-bleed only after another; one per round; review not triage's) — without it SKILL.md 〈优先级〉 (红线 outrank 细则, and two conflicting rules resolve to the stricter one) would make item 6c dead text. This is the card's own 「amends the earlier 『你只处理分诊』 for this one case only」, written where that rule lives.

Acceptance line of the card: a reader of `SKILL.md` alone now learns that a p0 is dispatched in the same round, past `batch`, the depth wait and every concurrency cap, and that lower-priority dev work pauses to make room (L119), and that triage's only claim/dispatch is the unclaimed-p0 stop-bleed (L35).

## Line budget — every edited line, bytes, and the home of every deleted line

Ceilings (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` `CEILINGS`): SKILL.md 319, execution-duties 188, landing-operations 101, triage-duties 102 — every one at headroom 0 on `origin/main` 9ff8154c. The order read triage-duties' ceiling as 103 with one line of headroom; the ledger says it was lowered 103 → 102 when the whole-card cloud route merged, so that file paid for both of its new lines. Every new line is paid by deleting a line whose content has a home elsewhere (named per line); no re-wrap is used as currency; every prose line is ≤120 bytes (`wc -c` without the newline); the one edited table row is metered by SKILL.md's widest-table-row pin (341 B, still L160), which is the rule for table rows (`classifyLine` exempts them from the 120-byte line rule). Line numbers in this section are `origin/main`'s.

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — 319 → 319

- after L34 **inserted** (111 B): `- 唯一例外:无主 p0 锚卡一轮即轮报、再一轮分诊只代派止血:每轮一张,复核非分诊。`
- L118 **rewritten in place** (124 B → 239 B; a table row — the file's widest row stays L160 at 341 B = the pin). Cell before: `插队:可超 \`batch\`、破轮次立即派发;⛔ 不豁免同文件串行、深度等待与认领协议`. Cell after: `插队:同轮立即派发,越过 \`batch\`、深度等待(\`LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD\`)与一切并发上限;无槽即暂停低级在飞 dev 腾位(机制 \`references/execution-duties.md\`);⛔ 不豁免同文件串行与认领协议`.

- after L25 **inserted** (117 B): `- p0 无槽或低级在飞同文件挡住 ⇒ 暂停腾位的最低级 dev:停会话、PR 留 draft、认领不动。`
- after L25 **inserted** (119 B): `- 卡记 \`Paused-for: #P0\`,⛔ 不丢弃、不回退、不 force-push;p0 落地即复活该 dev,同认领同分支。` — the file spells the placeholder the way the corpus spells `#` placeholders (angle brackets around p0); it is rendered here without them so this body survives the platform's sanitizer.
- after L48 **inserted** (112 B): `- 每轮每次唤醒首读本车道开着的 \`priority:p0\`,无人认领即同轮认领派发,⛔ 不等下轮。`
